answer: Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 33 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. The garden schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the lotus checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. An adversary wanting 157 effective identities must lock that capital for 33 epochs and keep it locked through every dawn audit. That is 22 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
